At Energy & Utilities level this capability reads as: market context summarized with citations to exchange data and risk policy (trader coverage widened per desk). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. The first two weeks lock the baseline: your team and ours measure the current metric together and sign it. Weeks 3–8 carry the pilot on bounded scope — a single decision path, workflow, plant or portfolio — and a control owner on your side owns the evidence. Weeks 9–12 industrialize: runbooks, monitoring, enablement, and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Missing a gate produces a documented decision to stop or redirect — never a silent extension.
